(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __and is further based on characteristics of the current picture__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __and is further determined based on characteristics of the current picture__. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 33: A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence.
